concept.title: What is Sum-up of numbers
concept.shortdesc: Here you will learn what is sum-up.

conbody.p: Subtraction is the process of finding the addition between two numbers by taking adding number into another.

When using a calculator,
Enter the first number.
Click plus icon.
Enter the second number.
Click equals icon.
Check the output. to get the result.
It shows how much remains after adding one value into another.
